library.name: radix-ui-themes
library.note: The reference profile, and how to re-derive it.  Facts come from radix-ui/themes: components and what they render by adapt-react over src/components, closed value sets from the sibling <name>.props.tsx files, and the token layer from src/styles/tokens/*.css. All of it public, all of it MIT.  Level, surface, description and the twin pairs are AUTHORED here. They are the worked example of the tier no library ships — one reading of a public library, not its own words.
